Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Another question about specific cards, which
can probably be extrapolated to others:

1) Can Hidden Lurker be "chained"? Can you keep
adding vampires to the fight, or can there only
be one Hidden Lurker per combat? I assume the
latter, going by the Sabbat War card text...

2) Can Spying Mission (sup) be "stacked"? I know you
can't use the same Action Mod twice during the
_same_ action, but can I send a vampire on a
Spying Mission, and then next turn send him on another
Spying Mission, and then the third turn burn both to
bleed at +4?

2a) Can Spying Mission be used in conjuction with
Night Moves? Get the +6 Stealth, but get the
delayed bonus instead of the bleed?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:
> 1) Can Hidden Lurker be "chained"? Can you keep
> adding vampires to the fight, or can there only
> be one Hidden Lurker per combat? I assume the
> latter, going by the Sabbat War card text...

Only one, because after the first one you no longer
have a acting minion-blocking minion combat, which is
required by Hidden Lurker.

> 2) Can Spying Mission (sup) be "stacked"? I know you
> can't use the same Action Mod twice during the
> _same_ action, but can I send a vampire on a
> Spying Mission, and then next turn send him on another
> Spying Mission, and then the third turn burn both to
> bleed at +4?

Yes.

> 2a) Can Spying Mission be used in conjuction with
> Night Moves? Get the +6 Stealth, but get the
> delayed bonus instead of the bleed?

Yes.
